def rule(ctx):
    # Priority:
    #   1. fewest duties so far (balance count)
    #   2. most duties left before maintenance (preserve capacity, avoid early maintenance)
    #   3. fewest duty hours so far (balance hours)
    #   4. earliest ready time (use the robot idle longest; keep freshly charged ones available)
    ordered = sorted(ctx.available, key=lambda r: (r.count, -r.duties_left, r.hours, r.ready))
    actions = [("reuse", r) for r in ordered]
    # Preferred new type: gene's choice if still allowed, otherwise any available type.
    if ctx.left[ctx.gene_type] > 0:
        actions.append(("new", ctx.gene_type))
    else:
        for k in range(len(ctx.types)):
            if ctx.left[k] > 0:
                actions.append(("new", k))
                break
    return actions
